empirical_tests.observation: Process spawns, initializes CLR v4.0.30319, loads MFC140u.dll, blocks on modal activation dialog in session 22 without GUI context.
empirical_tests.finding: Licensing dialog is modal Win32 dialog created before main ribbon window loop.

empirical_tests.observation: Throws LicenseException: 'You must activate BarTender with a valid product key code to use the BarTender Print Service API.'
empirical_tests.finding: Confirmed strict enterprise licensing gate at managed API boundary.

empirical_tests.observation: Resolves registered CLSID {D5856250-13D3-11D1-9D2B-00609787E3AE} and launches BarTend.exe /Automation. In an unactivated installation, the process displays a modal activation prompt and halts, requiring interactive desktop interaction to acknowledge licensing.
empirical_tests.finding: COM ProgID registration and process activation launch are verified; however, successful COM invocation does not constitute proof of unattended automated execution in an unactivated environment.
